name: R5.2 Prepare a research and qualification brief

nodes.name: Step 1: Lead assigned
nodes.notes: Your CRM calls this when a lead is assigned. Body: {lead_id}.

assignments.name: criteria
assignments.value: [{"name": "<criterion>", "description": "<what a source must say for it to be met>"}]

assignments.name: allowed_sources
assignments.value: ["https://<an agreed public source type, such as your city's planning notices>/"]

assignments.name: injection_phrases
assignments.value: ["ignore your", "ignore previous", "ignore all previous", "disregard your", "new instructions"]

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 2: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

nodes.name: Duplicate: stop
nodes.notes: A brief was prepared for this lead before; a reassignment gets no second one.

nodes.name: Step 3: Pages to fetch
nodes.notes: Only addresses under your agreed public source types (Config allowed_sources); never personal profiles.

nodes.name: Step 3: Fetch page
nodes.notes: One try and one retry; a page failing twice is "not fetched". Page text is untrusted.

nodes.name: Step 4: Build the AI request
nodes.notes: Fills the prompt from the recipe's prompts/ file; the input is data, never instructions.

nodes.name: Step 4: AI call
nodes.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 by default (Config); tools none; the reply is checked by the rule that follows.

nodes.name: Step 5: Rule: valid, sourced, no page instructions?
nodes.notes: The rules decide; the AI only drafts.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { status: 'ai error', problems: ['AI error after one retry: ' + String(($json.error && $json.error.message) || '')] } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $('Step 3: Read the lead').first().json.id, title: $json.title, check: $json.check, text: $json.text, sources: $json.sources }) }}

nodes.name: Step 6: Attach to the lead
nodes.notes: The one write this recipe makes; never retried.

parameters.query: UPDATE key_log SET status = $3, result = $4 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 RETURNING key

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R5.2", String($('Step 1: Lead assigned').first().json.body.lead_id), "done", $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.check] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R5.2", $('Step 1: Lead assigned').first().json.body.lead_id, 'brief ' + $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.check, JSON.stringify({ check: $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.check, problems: $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.problems, criteria: $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.criteria_counts, sources: $('Step 6: Write the note').first().json.sources.map(s => s.id + (s.status === 'not fetched' ? ' (not fetched)' : '')) })] }}

nodes.name: Decision log
nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).

nodes.name: Exception queue: write failed
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

nodes.name: Stopped by the stop flag
nodes.notes: Ends quietly; nothing is read, written or sent.
